name: plugin-permission-diff
description: Review capability, network, authentication, skill, and privacy-boundary changes between plugin revisions.

interface.shortDescription: Review plugin capability expansion before release
interface.longDescription: Compare two local ChatGPT or Codex plugin revisions and produce a redacted, evidence-linked review of expanded capabilities and data boundaries.
defaultPrompt: Compare these two local plugin folders and explain every permission expansion.
Create a CI-ready permission diff for this plugin update.
